ui_bugs.issue: MD-09 fiat estimate never renders. Rows tx=1293(BTC, pending), 1292(ETH, pending), 1282(ETH, pending) show USD Value '—' instead of '≈ $x'. [data-testid=tx-fiat-estimate] count on /transactions Unpaid tab = 0. /api/public/tickers returns BTC 82943 & ETH 2643.6 and is fetched twice on load, so useUsdRates has data. Root cause: index.tsx maps `status: toTxStatusBucket(item.status)` which turns a raw DB status flowing through the backend display bucket into 'unpaid'; TransactionsTable.tsx line 119 only enables the estimate for status in {awaiting_payment, pending, processing, confirmed} — 'unpaid' is not included so `open=false` and the branch never runs. Fix option A: add 'unpaid' to the open-set. Fix option B: use bucket-aware set (include 'awaiting_payment','pending','processing','confirmed','underpaid','unpaid'). Fix option C: pass through a rawStatus field for this check.

rca of the issue: MD-09: TransactionsTable.displayValue uses `open = tx.status === 'awaiting_payment' || 'pending' || 'processing' || 'confirmed'` while Transactions/index.tsx line 246 sets `status: toTxStatusBucket(item.status)`. helpers/txStatus.ts::toTxStatusBucket normalises the backend display status to one of the 8 buckets — including 'unpaid' when the raw DB row lacks on-chain funds/receipt. For BTC/ETH rows that show as 'Unpaid' in the UI but are still awaiting payment on-chain, tx.status ends up as 'unpaid' which is NOT in the open-set, so the estimate branch is skipped and '—' is rendered. Reproduction: /transactions on The Dev Store → Unpaid tab → rows 1293/1292/1282 have USD Value '—' rather than '≈ $79.80' etc. Mitigation: include 'unpaid' in the open-set (safe: MD-09 spec text says 'awaiting/pending rows' which is the same user-facing category as 'Unpaid') OR route the raw DB status through the ExtendedTransaction and check against it.
